seeds.content: Performance problem: API p99 latency exceeds 200ms threshold. Auth middleware running on origin servers adds ~180ms per request due to JWT verification overhead.

Options explored for latency reduction: (1) Edge auth via CDN — moves verification to edge PoPs; (2) JWT caching — risks stale token acceptance; (3) Token pre-warming — operational complexity without latency gain. Edge auth selected. CAUSED_BY: PROB-001.
Auth moved to Cloudflare edge workers. Eliminates origin round-trip for token verification. Resolves p99 latency problem. RESOLVED_BY: PROB-001.

Signing algorithm: Ed25519 instead of JWT/RS256. Ed25519 verification at 0.3ms vs JWT at 40ms on edge workers. Performance difference justified the algorithm change. DEPENDS_ON: DEC-001 (edge auth decision). CAUSED_BY: DEC-001.
Token validity: 15-minute signed tokens. Short expiry reduces revocation risk at edge without a blocklist. CAUSED_BY: DEC-002 (Ed25519 algorithm choice).

probes.expected_answer: Moving auth to Cloudflare edge workers (DEC-001)
probes.expected_rationale: Edge auth eliminates origin round-trip, resolving the 200ms p99 threshold breach.

probes.expected_answer: Ed25519 verifies in 0.3ms vs JWT's 40ms on edge workers. The performance difference justified the algorithm change.
probes.expected_rationale: Ed25519 was chosen because of its verification speed advantage on edge workers (0.3ms vs 40ms for JWT/RS256), which was critical given we moved auth to the edge.

probes.question: What does the Ed25519 signing algorithm decision depend on, and what did it cause?
probes.expected_answer: The Ed25519 signing decision depends on the edge auth decision (DEC-001) and caused the 15-minute token validity policy (DEC-003).
probes.expected_rationale: DEC-002 (Ed25519) has a DEPENDS_ON edge to DEC-001 (edge auth) and a CAUSED_BY edge; DEC-003 (15-min tokens) was caused by DEC-002.
